manifest.purpose: Correct golden answer for submission/recovered_rtl.v. Defines exactly one module 'recovered_datapath(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input [1:0] sel, output [7:0] y)', purely combinational, no clock/latches, no vendor primitives. Implements: sel=00 -> y=a+b (8-bit wraparound), sel=01 -> y=a-b (8-bit wraparound two's complement), sel=10 -> y=a&b, sel=11 -> y=a|b. Uses a single combinational always @* block with case(sel) or continuous assign with ternary chain over sel, driving y for all 4 sel values with no extra carry-out bits. This is the ground-truth word-level recovery of inputs/gate_netlist.v per the design_brief.md semantics; must compile standalone with iverilog and match gate_netlist.v exactly for all (a,b,sel) via simulation.
